news.title: Blue Dog Democrat drops ‘Zyn’ from campaign nicotine pouch can
news.summary: Rep. Marie Gluesenkamp Perez (D-Wash.) dropped the word “Zyn” from a piece of campaign merchandise inspired by the popular nicotine pouch brand’s packaging after its parent company reportedly asked her to stop.
